input.quote: 3.1 The Company shall pay HDI thirty percent (3016) of the Net Sales in excess of Eleven Thousand Dollars ($11,000) per calendar month.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-terms mechanic in either direction: the economic terms (Section 3, Fees; Payment) fix a flat 30% share of Net Sales above a monthly threshold, with no obligation on the Company to extend to HDI any better terms granted to third parties and no obligation to match third-party offers. Searches for "most favored", "no less favorable", "favorable", "pricing", "discount", "other customers" and "right of first" returned nothing relevant. The only related restriction is the Section 6.1 exclusivity covenant (the Company not participating in similar Internet projects for Deerskin Products), which is a scope/exclusivity term rather than an MFN or best-terms obligation and is addressed under the exclusivity rule, not here. Absence of any MFN burdening the Company meets the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
